line: Painted backgrounds, flat hard-shadow cels, light glowing through the frame, played back from tape.
line_cn: 手绘背景、硬阴影赛璐璐、透过画面的光，从录像带回放。
lineage: Structure after lemo-opuscar STYLE.md (CC BY 4.0); text written for the H3 pipeline.
essence: Four layers in contrast: airbrushed painted background, flat cel with hard-edged shadow, backlit glow, VHS playback.
Outlines are coloured, never pure black; shadows are one hard shape per form.
Characters step at 12 fps while the camera and light move smoothly.
Night cities, wet streets, neon reflections and window gold.
Stillness as drama: a held close-up with a light band sweeping across it.
not: Not modern digital anime: no gradients inside cels, no clean 60 fps.
Not moe: no giant eyes, no blush hatching.
Not a film-print pastiche: tape noise, not gate weave.
materials: Background: painted gouache and airbrush, soft gradients, glowing windows.
Cel: flat fills, one hard shadow shape, coloured line.
Playback: chroma bleed, faint scanlines, darkened corners.

rules: Each hour has its own colour model: night city (indigo, violet, magenta, cyan, window gold); seaside noon (cobalt, white, sand, coral).
The protagonist has one accent colour that pops in every set.
Skin keeps its own colour under coloured light; never tint the whole frame.

rules: Titles can be a white flash card in the assembler.

Speed lines and a one-beat freeze before impact.
Cut on bars; a white flash is the loudest transition.

pitfalls.problem: The model produces modern smooth anime with gradients.
pitfalls.fix: Say 'flat cel colours, one hard shadow shape, coloured outline, 1980s OVA' in the beat suffix; texture vhs.
Describe 'narrow realistic eyes, long faces, 1980s character design'.
Name skin colour explicitly in character elements.
